messages:
maya: FYI we flagged CVE-2026-1234 (libssl) in the runtime base image used by Dedicated. Small patch but affects live nodes. Need a tight rebuild + sign + canary tomorrow 09:30 PT. Main asks: minimal image, KMS-backed signing, auditable builder SA, canary subset, rollback playbook.

liam: Inventory request: which services mount the runtime rootfs? want exact list to estimate restart impact.

anika: I can add a CI job to produce deterministic artifacts + SBOM. Plan to use cosign with the KMS plugin so CI runner never stores keys. Will emit cosign bundle for provenance.

ron: IAM guidance: do NOT grant broad iam.serviceAccounts.signBlob. Create ephemeral signer SA with only kms.sign and registry push rights scoped to staging. Also create a namespace-scoped RoleBinding for the build-runner.

security-bot: Auto-scan: redwood/runtime:latest -> CVE-2026-1234 (libssl) severity=HIGH. Full details: https://scans.internal/reports/3321 :warning:

maya: Proposed steps:
- 1) request ephemeral signer SA + narrow RoleBinding (ron)
- 2) CI job builds minimal image, produces SBOM + distroless layer (anika)
- 3) cosign sign via KMS plugin, upload bundle (anika)
- 4) push to staging with tag rebase-libssl-2026-03-18 (anika)
- 5) canary deploy to 3 Dedicated nodes (liam)
- 6) monitor traces, token cost, error rates, and audit logs; rollback if any regression (maya)
Who can own 1/3/5?

anika: I'll own CI + signing. CI job snippet I'm adding:
```
./ci/build-runtime --minimal --sbom out/sbom.json --out-image gcr.io/redwood/staging/rebase-libssl-2026-03-18
cosign sign --key k8s://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/cosign --output-bundle out/cosign.bundle
```
CI runner will be attached to ephemeral signer SA with kms.sign permission.

liam: I'll take the canary. I'll reserve 3 Dedicated machines, tag them `canary-libssl`, and create a zero-downtime restart checklist. Need image push window and expected rollout timeline.

ron: I'll raise the IAM ticket for a 4-hour ephemeral signer SA. I'll also add an audit-log filter to capture `serviceAccounts:signBlob` and `kms.cryptoKeyVersions.sign` to sec-logging.

security-bot: Reminder: include SBOM reference in the cosign attestation bundle (`--attachment sbom.json`) so provenance links are preserved.

maya: I'll draft a short rollback playbook and a dashboard with latency, error-rate, and token-cost panels. We should do a 09:15 PT check-in before the canary.

deploy-bot: Job queued: `staging-rebase-libssl-1714509876` submitted by anika  ETA ~2.5h.

anika: Uploaded runbook draft and CI PR: https://docs.internal/runbooks/rebase-libssl-1714509876 + https://git.internal/redwood/ci/pull/482. It lists the exact build commands and the quick rollback commands.

maya: tagging @oncall and eng-runtime for awareness. Will post a final go/no-go 30m before start. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
